freeze_control.change_control: A class, scope, population source, status or admission-gate change requires a new registry version and pre-outcome freeze record.

revision_history.reason: Add leveraged/inverse class coverage and U0-to-T2 derivation controls before any population snapshot or outcome.

purpose: Create a class-neutral domestic securities and derivatives discovery register so a convenient data subset cannot silently become the strategy universe. It is not an eligible universe, allocation, screen, recommendation or action.

scope_boundary.included_research_area: Domestic exchange-listed securities, public funds/REITs and domestic listed derivatives that may be researched subject to venue, product, route, data, suitability and risk gates.
scope_boundary.not_an_exclusion: An omitted product, a missing dossier or unavailable data means unresearched or evidence-pending, not economically rejected.
scope_boundary.access_boundary: No row assumes an individual's brokerage access, suitability, tax treatment or permission to trade.

class_status_values.unresearched: No case-specific primary population, product or data packet has been accepted.
class_status_values.evidence_pending: A discovery path or limited fact evidence exists, but no class-wide point-in-time population and admission package has passed.
class_status_values.data_qualified: Reserved for a future class that has passed a frozen data and admission test. No current row has this status.
class_status_values.out_of_scope_with_reason: Requires a dated legal, operational or mandate reason and independent review. No current row uses this status.

population_control.refresh_rule: Before a future decision-universe snapshot, freeze a source-specific population-refresh calendar, capture date, query definition, expected count and reconciliation exception log.
population_control.survivorship_control: Delisted, terminated, expired, suspended, merged, renamed and otherwise unavailable items remain in historical population records with their dated status; they cannot disappear because they are inconvenient.
population_control.selection_boundary: No class or item becomes a T2 candidate merely because it appears in this registry or because another class lacks data.
population_control.u0_to_t2_derivation_requirement: A future T2 freeze must retain the U0 snapshot hash; per-class population, qualified and excluded counts; every T2 parent_class_id; pre-frozen rule ID; inclusion/exclusion reason; and independently approved exception log.

common_admission_gates: Dated primary identity, venue and lifecycle/status record.
Authorized point-in-time data with as_of, available_at, revision and raw-hash lineage.
Complete cash-event, corporate-action, settlement and tradability history appropriate to the class.
Dated tax, cost, route, limit, suspension and no-fill evidence.
Class-specific economic/product research and risk mapping.
Historical membership and termination treatment that prevents survivorship bias.
Independent R0/R1/risk review with no user-specific access assumption.

classes.candidate_primary_population_source: Future official SSE/SZSE listed-security and disclosure population capture, reconciled by venue.

classes.next_gate: Build a U0 population master before naming issuer candidates.

required_before_status_change: Dated scope rationale and primary population source.
new_class_intake.prohibited_shortcut: A new class cannot be admitted because its marketing label, historic distribution, coupon, public continuous series or one convenient current product appears attractive.

current_decision: The registry creates no approved asset class, product, contract, allocation, holding or action. All current classes and items remain q=0.
